# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 71 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Mich. 130, Shepherd of Hermas 71 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_071_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 8, Part 2 — The Meaning of the Rods

**71:1** "Those whose rods were found withered and moth-eaten — these are the apostates and betrayers of the church, who blasphemed the Lord in their sins and were further ashamed of the name of the Lord which was called upon them. These are utterly dead to God. And you see that not one of them repented, even though they heard the words which you proclaimed. From such people life has withdrawn."

**71:2** "But those who surrendered rods that were dry and cracked — these too are near to the apostates. They did not apostatize, but they never bore fruit. For just as a dry rod bears no fruit, so also these people do live, but they bear no fruit of any good work. Their repentance, however, remains possible for them, if they repent quickly. But if they delay, they too will share in the death of the first group."

**71:3** "Lord," I said, "why is repentance still possible for them, but not for those first ones? Their rods were just as similar." "For this reason repentance is still possible for them," he said — "they did not blaspheme their Lord, nor did they become betrayers of the church. But through desire for gain they deceived and led their own lives according to their own desires. Let them repent, therefore."

**71:4** "Those who surrendered rods half-dry and cracked — hear about them. Those who are perpetually double-minded and who speak evil of one another — these are those whose rods were half-dry. Many of them repented when they heard my commandments, and those who repented were given a dwelling in the first tower. But those who repented more sluggishly were given a dwelling in the second tower."

**71:5** "Those who surrendered their rods green but dried at the tips — these are those who were faithful but wealthy, and who were immersed in the affairs of this age. They are ashamed of the truth. Some of these, when they heard my commandments, repented and were found good. The rest remain in their affairs and are cut off from the holy ones. These will find the place assigned to the third tower difficult to enter."

---

*LOGOS renders according to the Greek text of P.Mich. 130 with attention to formal correspondence and the typological significance of each rod category in Similitude 8.*
